urls.rationale: §6B-2-1 West Virginia Ethics Commission created — enforcing agency for the lobbying regime.
§6B-2-2 General powers and duties of the Ethics Commission — the body that administers lobbyist registration and reporting.
§6B-2-2a Probable Cause Review Board — enforcement scaffolding for lobbyist violations.
§6B-2-3 Advisory opinions; enforcement; applicability; legislative review; rule making — authority for lobbyist enforcement and rulemaking.
§6B-2-3a Complaints — complaint mechanism applicable to lobbyist violations.
§6B-2-4 Processing complaints; dismissals; hearings; disposition; judicial review — adjudication process for lobbyist disclosure violations.
§6B-2-9 Special prosecutor authorized — enforcement remedy for Ethics Act including lobbying violations.
§6B-2-10 Violations and penalties — Ethics Commission penalty backbone that 6B-3-9 penalties operate within.

notes: Selected Ethics-Commission enforcement scaffolding only. Sections 6B-2-5/5a/5b/5c/6/7/8 are ethics-standards-for-officials and financial-disclosure provisions for public officials/employees — separate regime, out of scope. §6B-2-11 has no anchor text and is omitted as likely empty/repealed.
